source: Phase 169 Plan-01 audit per CONTEXT D-02/D-03; TOPOLOGY ONLY; prefix output strings resolve through seniority.PREFIX_FORMS / assembly.substituent_prefix_forms at runtime and are NEVER duplicated here. Scope bounded to the empirically-firing splittable composites measured by scripts/audit_drop23_reach.py (ester 482 + thioester 24 events). Citations: QMUL Blue Book (https://iupac.qmul.ac.uk/BlueBook) + offline IUPAC_BlueBook_Organic_Naming_Guide.docx.

entries.notes: Losing ester -C(=O)-O-R: the carbonyl carbon stays in the substituent chain bearing the chalcogen (=O -> resolves to the oxo prefix via the ketone PREFIX_FORMS entry) and the -O-R linker (-> resolves to the alkoxy/ether prefix via the ether dispatcher). Verified example: monoethyl succinate -> 4-ethoxy-4-oxobutanoic acid (OPSIN-RT connectivity-InChI match).

Losing thioester -C(=O)-S-R: the carbonyl carbon stays in the substituent chain bearing the chalcogen (=O -> resolves to the oxo prefix via the ketone PREFIX_FORMS entry) and the -S-R linker (-> resolves to the alkylsulfanyl prefix via the thioether dispatcher). Verified example: S-ethyl monothiosuccinate -> 4-(ethylsulfanyl)-4-oxobutanoic acid (OPSIN-RT connectivity-InChI match).

Losing chain-end imidate -C(=NH)-O-R: P-65.1.3.1.2(2) prefers the SIMPLE prefixes imino + alkoxy at the end of a carbon chain over the compound C-...carbonimidoyl prefix (that compound form is the ring-parent PIN, handled separately by get_alkoxycarbonimidoyl_prefix). The imidate carbon stays in the chain bearing =NH (-> the imino prefix via the imine PREFIX_FORMS entry) and the -O-R linker (-> the alkoxy prefix via the ether dispatcher). Verified example: OC(=O)CCC(=N)OC -> 4-imino-4-methoxybutanoic acid (BB 30035 (PIN) hydroxy template '4-hydroxy-4-iminobutanoic acid'; OPSIN-RT connectivity match).
